post_hoc_disclaimer: Post hoc check on synthetic players, run after the pre-registered A1/A3g player-level results were already reported. Not a pre-registered arm; treat as exploratory.
question: player level: how does pooling degrade when only a FRACTION f of a player's k games are actually cheating games (the rest are that player's clean games from the same band)? Contrast with A1/A3g's own all-cheating (f=1.0) player.

f1_check_vs_published.note: k<=20 values from this script's own kmax=100 draw will not be bit-exact to the published kmax=20 (A0) run: np.argpartition's first-k slots are the k smallest keys but are not internally sorted, so a kmax=100 draw's first-20 columns are not guaranteed to be the same 20 players as a kmax=20 draw. Agreement is judged by falling inside the published CI, not by exact equality.
